# A scroll's @reachEnd asks again as its content grows while its end still
# shows, on html, where the browser lays the page out -- the content a slot
# renders included, and a first page shorter than the scroll.
#
# The sentinel asked again when the scroll's height grew, and that stands
# still while the content is shorter than the scroll, so a short first page
# asked for one page more and no further. And it watched the scroll's direct
# children alone, where content under an `if` renders into a
# `display:contents` span, which has no box to grow. It now asks where it has
# moved, and watches what is added anywhere below the scroll.
#
# html alone: no other target's test driver lays a page out, so none fires
# @reachEnd of itself there; a test's trigger does (component_scroll.txtar).

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import seq "sngl:seq"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component page ui.node {
    var shown = 1

    ui.scroll #list(style={height=400px}, @reachEnd {
        if shown < 5 {
            shown += 1
        }
    }) {
        if shown > 0 {
            ui.vbox {
                for var i = seq.count(shown) {
                    ui.text(value="row {i}", style={height=150px})
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testAScrollOfALoopAsksUntilItsEndIsGone(t test.Test, c page) {
    // Each row is 150px of a 400px box: the end shows until three rows fill
    // it, and the grid stops asking there.
    t.wait(func() => c.shown >= 4, 3000)
    t.assert(c.shown >= 4)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/page/1 --
